title: Per-source URL allowlist (INGF-02 deliverable 1; PRD §37.4, §35.2, plan §2.1 A2)
description: The schema of pipelines/adapters/<group-id>/allowlist.yaml. This ticket owns the schema and the loader; modules 06-10 own the instances. Constraints this vocabulary cannot express (schemes == [https], a non-empty hosts list, an IP-literal host, approved_max_bytes requiring its reason, path prefixes starting with /) are enforced in policy.py and separately tested; the validator this repository ships (contracts.jsonschema_min) rejects an unknown keyword rather than passing a schema it cannot enforce, so minItems/uniqueItems/format are deliberately absent.

group_id.description: The uppercase PRD §40.2-40.6 Group ID; must equal the directory name uppercased.

schemes.description: HTTPS only (PRD §21.1). Any other value is a load error.

hosts.description: At least one host rule; enforced in policy.py.

min_request_interval_ms.description: Politeness only; carried here and consumed by INGF-08, not enforced by INGF-02.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Politeness only; carried here and consumed by INGF-08, not enforced by INGF-02.

approved_max_bytes.description: null = MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES. A number is the PRD §37.4 source-specific approved limit and REQUIRES approved_max_bytes_reason.

deny_paths.description: Explicit denials, evaluated after path_prefixes and winning over them.
